race.description: Qld Cotton Part Of Olam Agri Hcp (Bm55)
race.comment: LADY WILLPOWER (8) may have suffered from the dreaded second-up syndrome last time out but go on the solid win here when resuming. Gets in well at the weights with the claim and is drawn to get all the favours from the inside alley. Plenty to like about her prospects. The well-related HELL OF A LAD (2) (full to G3 winner Zip Lock) resumes here but has revved up for this with a recent trial and has placed two of four when fresh before. Respect any market confidence. DEEP TIARA (5) has been right there in all three runs this preparation and looks to be working up to another victory. In the mix. STABILIZER (14) hasn't been too far away of late and may earn some minor money. MONDELLO (9) is a last-start winner who shouldn't be underestimated.
